Calamity Stride.name: Calamity Stride
Calamity Stride.description: The user steps onto a burning, flooded or collapsed street, breathes its air once, and adapts by the end of their next turn to every environmental hazard across a whole city block for the rest of the scene: fire, cold, water, toxic gas, smoke, live wires and falling debris. They cross the block unharmed, shield and haul groups of trapped people out, and drive foes back for heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, they only shove them clear. Fresh enemy attacks still land first, and afterward the user cannot adapt again until they rest an hour. Strain: severe.
